description: Given a natural-language task description (e.g., 'I'm building a tool-using agent that runs shell commands'), return the most relevant patterns grouped by suite. Use this as a starting point for any cross-cutting design question; then follow up with get_requirement on specific pattern_ids. Defaults to verbosity='compact' (cheap triage); pass 'full' to inline snippets and confidence flags.
name: find_patterns_for_task
